name: Xcel/SPS Panhandle distribution corridor
ignitionHistory: A decayed pole on this system ignited Smokehouse Creek, 26 Feb 2024.

name: Pedernales EC Hill Country feeder
ignitionHistory: Rural feeder through oak-juniper; two ignitions from conductor slap in the 2022 season.

name: Oncor Eastland feeder
ignitionHistory: Suspected ignition source of the 2022 Eastland Complex; PSPS used only as a last resort.

name: LCRA transmission, west Travis
ignitionHistory: Transmission ROW through Balcones juniper; vegetation cycle cut to 3 years in 2023.

name: Phillips 66 Borger refinery
ignitionHistory: Refinery flank inside the 2024 Windy Deuce smoke plume; grass up to the fence line.

name: Valero McKee refinery
ignitionHistory: Open shortgrass on three sides; plant fire brigade on site.

name: Delek Big Spring refinery
ignitionHistory: Sits under the Caprock escarpment with mesquite pasture to the east.

name: Basin pipeline segment
ignitionHistory: Crude trunk line; pump stations sit on caliche pads in mesquite pasture.

name: Permian Express segment
ignitionHistory: Runs past the Delek refinery; ROW mowed twice a year.

name: Midland tank farm
ignitionHistory: Tank bunds kept clear; grass and mesquite beyond the berms.

name: Roscoe wind farm
ignitionHistory: Turbine pads and gravel roads through cotton and pasture; nacelle fires in 2019 and 2023.

name: Wildorado wind farm
ignitionHistory: Shortgrass prairie between turbine pads; county road access only.

name: Fredericksburg substation
ignitionHistory: Feeds the Hill Country feeder; oak-juniper up to the fence.

name: Pampa substation
ignitionHistory: Grassland substation on the SPS network north of Pampa.

name: Bluebonnet EC spur, Bastrop
ignitionHistory: Loblolly pine within falling distance of the conductor, as in 2011.

name: PEC spur, Wimberley
ignitionHistory: Spur along Cypress Creek hills; clearance behind schedule.

name: PEC spur, Spicewood
ignitionHistory: Serves the Pedernales Bend 2011 burn scar.

name: Golden Spread co-op line, Canyon
ignitionHistory: Crosses the Palo Duro rim breaks south-east of Canyon.

name: OG&E Logan County feeder
ignitionHistory: Downed conductors on this system started three of the March 2025 fires.

name: PSO Creek County feeder
ignitionHistory: Runs through the 2012 Mannford burn scar.

name: WFEC transmission near Anadarko
ignitionHistory: Mixed-grass prairie ROW; red-flag de-energisation protocol since 2024.

name: Cushing tank farm
ignitionHistory: The largest crude storage hub on earth, ringed by tallgrass and Cross Timbers.

name: OG&E substation, Stillwater
ignitionHistory: Serves the south-west Stillwater subdivisions.
